learning_outcomes.text: Adequate knowledge of mathematics, science and related engineering discipline-specific subjects; Ability to use theoretical and applied knowledge in these fields in complex engineering problems.
Ability to identify, formulate and solve complex engineering problems; Ability to select and apply appropriate analysis and modeling methods for this purpose
Ability to design a complex system, process, device or product to meet specific requirements under realistic constraints and conditions; Ability to apply modern design methods for this purpose

Ability to select and use modern techniques and tools necessary for the analysis and solution of complex problems encountered in engineering applications; Ability to use information technologies effectively
Ability to work effectively in interdisciplinary teams
Ability to communicate effectively verbally and in writing; knowledge of at least one foreign language; Writing effective reports and understanding written reports

syllabus_topics: Introduction, mass transfer mechanisms and diffusion coefficient.
Calculation of diffusivity in gas, liquid and porous media; Fick’s laws
Equation of continuity, mass transfer in stagnant fluids and in laminar flows, shell balances
Mass transfer coefficients in laminar and turbulent flows
Mass transfer theories; Film, Penetration and Surface renewal theories, Analogy
Phase equilibria, interfacial mass transfer, tworesistance theory
Vapor-liquid equilibria, batch distillation, flash distillation
Binary distillation and use of x-y diagram
Use of H-x,y diagram in distillation calculations
